# Test fixture provenance

Small binary SAS files used by the package's examples and tests. Full
attribution is in the repo-root `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`; summary:

- `missing_test.sas7bdat`, `missing_formats.sas7bcat`,
  `test_data_win.sas7bdat`, `test_formats_win.sas7bcat` — from the
  [pyreadstat](https://github.com/Roche/pyreadstat) test corpus (Apache-2.0).
- `dtdate.sas7bdat` — from the [Parso](https://github.com/epam/parso) test
  resources (Apache-2.0), original name `date_format_dtdate.sas7bdat`.
- `people.sas7bdat` — tiny synthetic teaching dataset (5 rows: ID, GENDER)
  from public SAS sample-file collections (earliest known source: LSU
  EXST7087 course data, 2006).

All files are unmodified copies.
